message: Nubank, Challenge 2025.2 Group A: cover with purple brand overlay on a photo of the Nu building.
layout_trick: Brand-colour diagonal overlay over a full-bleed building photo with the giant 'nu' logo visible, centred title and underlined subtitle.

message: Nubank at a glance: 100M+ clients, 63% customer CAGR, USD 11.5bn revenue and a five-engine ecosystem mix.
layout_trick: Three-panel 'at a glance': summary box with LatAm map, customer base bars with CAGR callout, and a donut-wheel of revenue streams with icons around a central logo.

message: Brazilian banking is concentrated in incumbents who underserve young and low-income borrowers.
layout_trick: Dense 4-chart page with a right-hand rounded sidebar of age personas (icon + demand) and a dashed highlight box on the underserved bar.

message: BUY: low-cost model, high usage today with higher monetization tomorrow, LatAm as next compounding engine.
layout_trick: Recommendation as a section divider: three thesis lines staggered along a dashed diagonal path with piggy-bank icons, and BUY in large type over the photo.

message: Divider reusing the thesis diagonal path, highlighting the first pillar.
layout_trick: Same divider template re-used at each section start with the active pillar highlighted (bold) and others dimmed, acting as a progress marker.

message: Nu emerges by serving customers incumbents excluded, and turns inclusion into profitability despite higher delinquency.
layout_trick: Four-quadrant page: horizontal bars of client age mix, numbered 1-2-3 acquisition-engagement-monetization flow with icons, founder quote card with photo, NPL line vs industry.

message: Vision of David Velez turned a risky model into a success via a world-class team and an asset-light model.
layout_trick: Founder photo plus career-logo chain (Morgan Stanley > Goldman > General Atlantic > Sequoia) and a pill-linked team cluster with headshots above fixed-assets and Basel charts.

message: A culture of clients, ownership and efficiency drives NPS and faster daily transactions than Bradesco.
layout_trick: Left stack of four culture-value tags aligned to right-hand evidence; side-by-side phone UI step-flow showing PIX in 42s vs 1m17 with numbered screens.

message: Equity incentive culture (SOPs, RSUs) and low turnover ensured continuity until profitability.
layout_trick: Two rounded explainer cards (SOP vs RSU) with key terms, next to turnover bars and a net-income chart with a dashed annotation box.

message: Efficiency starts at acquisition (CAC) and persists operationally: efficiency ratio and clients per employee vs Itau.
layout_trick: Two stacked chart pairs with a lilac callout containing a numbered 'Itau would have to fire all employees + liquidate 44% of assets' equivalence.

message: Efficiency delivers industry-leading ROAE (28%) and a DuPont breakdown shows returns come from margin, not leverage.
layout_trick: Horizontal ROAE ranking bar with Nubank highlighted, paired with ROAE/ROAA/leverage DuPont lines and an equation callout box.

message: Brazil's unbanked pool is shrinking; addressable TAM narrows to ~18M after digital barriers.
layout_trick: Brazil regional map with a funnel panel (173M > banked > no internet > no phone > TAM 18M) stepped in decreasing lilac shades, plus founder quote strip.

message: Brand investment reduces opex ratio and makes Nu the most searched fintech with higher retention.
layout_trick: Four evidence charts under one claim: marketing/revenue bars, Google Trends line, and churning bars/area comparing Nubank vs Inter vs PagBank.

message: Brand drives early adoption and retention lifts ARPAC and LTV (463 USD, 57% CAGR).
layout_trick: Cohort adoption fan of lines (products per client by tenure) shaded by vintage with a gradient legend, next to ARPAC-by-tenure bars with LTV callout.

message: Lending is the central monetization engine, diversified across payroll, FGTS, private payroll and unsecured loans.
layout_trick: 100% stacked credit-mix bars with dashed highlight on the growing loan layers, beside a grey card list with icons per product (secured vs unsecured).

message: Banco Inter leads recent private payroll growth but with higher delinquency; Nu stays selective.
layout_trick: Competitor page recoloured in the rival's orange palette with its logo replacing the Nu logo, signalling a competitor-focused slide.

message: Nu leads low-risk public payroll thanks to lower structural risk and cheaper rates.
layout_trick: Rate-ranking bar of public payroll across banks with Nubank first (highlighted) and CFO quote card with photo.

message: Nubank dominates unsecured credit via a proprietary AI engine, scaling safely with rising AUC.
layout_trick: Vertical process flow (customer data > ML model > custom offer > feedback) with news-clipping evidence, and an AUC improvement area chart as proof.

message: In SME lending, NuPay creates a data-reinforcing flywheel that improves underwriting.
layout_trick: Circular flywheel diagram (more merchants > more data > better underwriting > more credit) with a TAM bubble (11 Bn USD) and dashed definition box.

message: Next growth era is quality over quantity: public payroll, unsecured, SME credit lift ARPAC.
layout_trick: Synthesis rendered as a white rounded modal over the dimmed previous slide with three numbered takeaways and an arrow to the conclusion.

message: Section divider: LatAm becomes Nubank's next compounding engine.
layout_trick: Divider with the third thesis pillar active on the diagonal dashed path and icon coins.

message: Mexico is a complex market with low banking penetration and high cash usage that unlocks the next growth cycle.
layout_trick: LatAm map with callout tags per country (clients 23 vs 25) next to a deposit share ranking with country flags and a cash-usage bar.

message: In Mexico a universal simple product adapted to a cash economy (OXXO cash-in) and customers trusted Nu with deposits.
layout_trick: Phone mockup with numbered features, three logo/icon tiles for cash-in/digitalization/bill pay, and deposits curve with CAGR 74% callout.

message: Mexico's excluded middle class, sub-banked due to US-linked compliance dependency, is what Nu captured.
layout_trick: Income-level choropleth of Mexico with pins for branch concentration, plus code screenshot and 3x faster ramp-up stat.

layout_trick: Three bars labelled with bear/base/bull icons beside four assumption rows each with an icon in a lilac pill.

layout_trick: Incumbent logos row with bullet findings and a highlighted banner 'What we found across all incumbents', plus donut of market concentration.

layout_trick: Brazil vs Colombia regulatory comparison with scales icon, then cost-to-serve area chart falling over time and a 80% Brazil-based cost callout over a photo.

layout_trick: Four-step horizontal strip of icon tiles (lock, chart, heart, coin) with captions under each step linking acquisition to ARPAC.

message: Mercado Livre powers a two-sided merchant-consumer cash-based flywheel and pays fast growth in POS terminals.
